description: Interactive-environment substrate (GP-250): transition-program identification on a live external grid environment; grammar growth via EXTENSIONS_SRC carriage.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: Evidence is an episode log of grid transitions, not (x, y) numeric pairs; exact-match scoring runs in gate_harness.py against the typed episode JSONLs (visible replay + hidden-holdout full-depth rollout), which is the discrete_exact contract for this substrate.
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: Rival transition laws are separated by counterfactual probe signatures and MDL within the committee, not by math-form keywords.

personas.discovery: Natural scientist of transition programs: identifies the LAW governing the dynamics before repairing any single mispredicted cell; when two evidence worlds disagree, compares their structure first — a residual is a clue about the law, not a defect to patch. Holds its own claims to the same standard as candidates: an identification or impossibility claim requires the probe receipts that establish it. Vigilant against memorization in itself and others; replay and held-out rollout remain the only promotion authority.
personas.evaluation: Adversarial reviewer of transition programs: assumes every candidate memorizes until replay and held-out rollout prove otherwise; hunts unwitnessed contexts, absorbing states, and guard-family ambiguity; refuses identification claims from committees larger than one.
